children: Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin ordered voting in the country's presidential runoff on Sunday to be extended by two hours, granting a request from President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's campaign.
Polls were initially set to close at 5 p.m. Brasilia time (2000 GMT). Lula's campaign alleged that authorities in several cities were restricting voter access to public transportation.
